method: Read the page's own schema.org offer list (application/ld+json) verbatim; the raw offer descriptions are kept in raw_offers so a later fetch can be diffed against them.

free_tier.page_copy: Absolutely nothing for your first 100 subscribers.
free_tier.listed_features: Email creation, analytics, API access, custom domains, automation

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: page prints a 999999 subscriber / price placeholder and an email contact; no real cap or price is stated

notes: The 'Features' string above is the page's product-level list; the page does not print a per-plan feature matrix, so it is not evidence that every listed feature is on the Free plan. The stronger evidence for API-on-Free is the commons' own live probe of 2026-10-04 (governance/requests-to-the-human.md): GET /v1/emails -> 200, GET /v1/subscribers -> 200, POST /v1/emails (status=draft) -> 201, on the Free plan.
This records the subscriber cap only. The Free plan's sending limit (emails per month) was not read and is not recorded here.
Prices and caps are as of 2026-10-08 and can change; re-fetch and diff raw_offers before acting on them.
